defects.title: Durable native photo idempotence
defects.instructions: Native persistence must use source identity before copying bytes; same timestamp is not identity. Verify restart, repeated/lost replies, capacity and owner scoping. Supervisor added optional assetID and duplicate guard before attempt 4; inspect current code, not old reports.

historicalProvisionalCounters.note: Unvalidated Mac seed; not eligible for automatic escalation. Distinct attempted repairs require per-revision evidence reconciliation.

currentAssessment.evidence: attachPhoto computes identity from sourceAssetID or asset.localIdentifier and returns false through containsPhotoAsset before the capacity guard and before writing bytes (ActivityServices.swift:185-187, write at :205). This works at capacity and after a lost reply. Identity is matched by assetID only, never by timestamp (RecorderCore.swift:2276-2279). Two non-blocking notes: images are still decoded before the check, which is tracked by P01-PICKER-MEMORY, and acceptSuggestion discards the Bool at PhotoSuggestions.swift:80, so a repeated accept reports success without creating a second copy. Legacy photos with no assetID cannot be matched, which is correct.

defects.title: Stable map during sheet drag and safe-area first measurement
defects.instructions: Integration is real: ActivitySheet wraps the screen content at ActivityDetail.jsx:192, and pointer and arrow-key detents run through lib/activitySheet.js. Safe-area padding and the fixed page are in styles.css:1162-1165. The P0 'helper not integrated' claim is resolved, but three gaps remain. (1) The map is not fixed: on phones .detail-map-layer is flex:1 1 auto (styles.css:1163) beside the height-driven sheet, so every drag frame and each frame of the .28s height transition (styles.css:1140) changes the surface height. ResizeObserver then calls mount(), which sends appleMaps.resize (AppleMap.jsx:158-163,206). (2) The handle, the only drag target, has min-height:30px (styles.css:1141), below 44pt. (3) useState(viewportHeight) runs in the first render before .detail-sheet-page is committed, so querySelector returns null and the first measurement uses raw innerHeight without the top safe-area subtraction (ActivitySheet.jsx:9-24,32). It is only re-measured on a resize event, so rendered height and aria-valuenow can exceed the CSS max-height clamp at styles.css:1165. Existing ActivitySheet tests are real component tests, but 'exactly one resize' describes an instant jsdom change, not a drag. Required regression: Existing: ActivitySheet.test.jsx 'tracks a pointer without a height transition and restores detent snapping on release'; ActivityDetail.test.jsx 'keeps one map and never re-embeds it when the details sheet moves'. Needed: a screen-level test that a multi-frame drag leaves the native frame unchanged or coalesces resize to settle; a test that the first render uses the safe-area-adjusted height; a 44pt handle assertion.
